about_the_game:
Harem of Ankhutep is a visual novel set in the sun-drenched streets of Ankhutep, an ancient desert city where daily life unfolds in the shadow of gods, and monstergirls walk the same streets as everyone else as a natural part of everyday life. You, the player, begin your journey by escaping​ an attack on your homeland, and you arrive in Ankhutep to begin again, not as a warrior or a ruler, but as a humble craftsman.

If you like the demo, please consider supporting the game on Patreon to help the further development of the game (and receive game updates), the Patreon is AhaNubis, the developer name.

Here, you’ll share meals, trade stories, and slowly carve out a new life surrounded by friendship, romance, and small, meaningful moments. Yet beneath the city’s warmth lie quiet mysteries, and every bond you form may open the door to ancient secrets waiting just out of sight.

Forge relationships with a diverse cast of monstergirl heroines, each with her own unique personality, ambition, and desire. Your decisions shape your path, unlock unique scenes, and reveal different sides of the story.​

Features

  • Ancient Egyptian-inspired setting: Explore a city of temples, palaces, and hidden springs brought to life with rich detail. Hand-crafted 3D art creates​ a unique and compelling Egypt-inspired atmosphere.

  • Monster girl romance & friendship: Meet crocodile-, mushroom-, Anubis-​, lion-girls, and more, each with her own personality, charm, and secrets.

  • Spicy, Story-Driven Encounters: Sensual scenes woven into meaningful relationships, fully animated.

  • Mystery beneath the warmth – Discover secrets, uncover intrigue, and see different sides of Ankhutep depending on the choices you make.

  • Choices that matter: Shape your relationships and reveal different sides of Ankhutep with each choice.

Never afraid to speak her mind, Tamun has little patience for nonsense, but behind her teasing smirks and quick wit is someone who takes her role seriously. She admires strength and confidence, yet she’s just as fond of good wine and good company. Spend enough time with her, and you may find that her bite isn’t nearly as dangerous as her charm.

Where Tamun is sharp and outspoken, Raa speaks rarely, but when she does, her words linger. Calm and with a gaze that seems to see more than she says, she carries an air of mystery that can be both soothing and unsettling. Getting close to her means learning to listen between the silences.

Not always the sharpest thinker, but her heart is in the right place. Thalobek tends to leap before she looks, and sadly she also does not always have the best ideas. But her enthusiasm (and stubborn loyalty) tend to lead to her coming out on top either way, and what she lacks in brains, she makes up for with courage and a grin full of sharp teeth.

Gentle and thoughtful, Amanita lives quietly with her sisters in the shade of the caves. She’s kind and welcoming, but her dreamlike manner makes her feel almost otherworldly. Patient and nurturing, she’ll happily share her food and wisdom if you can get used to her unusual ways.

Resilient and determined, Darius is a traveler shaped by hardship and driven by a sense of destiny.​ Though burdened by the weight of past losses, his compassion and loyalty make him a natural protector to those he cares about. His journey is as much about self-discovery as it is about survival.

content_descriptors.notes: Contains depictions of consensual sexual acts, frequent nudity and depictions of violence (no gore).
